name: PREPARE_TO_STOP_SIGNALS_AHEAD_WHITE_TALL

w3-3_signals.desc: AS 1743 W3-3 traffic signal pictogram (national symbol reused; the sheet paints a 'W3-3-C standard warning sign')

notes: Department of Logistics and Infrastructure (DIPL) civil standard drawing, CAD sheet in colour; every dimension from the sheet unless stated; AS 1744 (plus0) spacing. Sheet CS1557 'Traffic signal advance warning sign' (mounting detail with the sign face): 1800 x 2600 board, R300, 25 wide black border strip, white; two 300 dia traffic lights at the top (drawn as rings: black annulus R175/R150 about (250, 298) and (1550, 298), positions measured), a painted W3-3-C standard warning sign 1365 across the diagonals (vertical chain 300/1365/125/660/150) centred, yellow paint Y14 with black border (yellow 10 / black 20 / R50 as AS 1743 W3-3) and the W3-3 signal pictogram (box measured 590 x 949 at (603, 530), larger than the national proportion), a 1500 x 660 rectangle of red paint R13 at 150 in / 1790 down with PREPARE / TO STOP in white. Letter height and series not stated: 180 measured, Series D by shape; cap tops 1890 / 2170 (measured 1885 / 2160, 95 in from the red panel), word gap 260 measured. The sheet's letters are spaced much wider than AS 1744 (PREPARE 1197 wide there, 1023 here), so no width check. Overlay: the sheet draws the diamond about 1400 across (its top tip at about 260, inside the 300 lamp zone); the stated 1365 is kept.
